name: PASS AI
author: Productive Minds

sections.description:
Pass AI is a modern WordPress plugin offering high-impact multimodal AI generation capabilities. It is designed to streamline content creation. ** Generate AI-powered text, images, and videos by integrating your own API keys from leading providers including OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic (Claude), xAI, and Runway.

⭐ Local Data & Full Control and Autonomy

  • Private Local Storage: Your data remains within your WordPress setup. All AI-generated content and media assets are stored locally, ensuring privacy and easy access.
  • Persistent Resource Library: Generate once and keep forever. Manage all saved content, media assets, and corresponding prompts through an integrated library for easy reference.
  • Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK): Maintain full cost control by connecting directly to OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic (Claude), xAI, and Runway using your API keys.
  • Direct Integration: A direct connection between your WordPress and your AI provider – No intermediary servers, processing, or enhancements.

📌 Key Features

  • Multi-Level API Key and User Policies: Choose the management style that works for your team:
    • Shared Access: All users share a single API key for each provider.
    • Individual Ownerships: Each user provides their own individual API key for independent usage and cost tracking.
  • WordPress Native: Built as a native implementation for stability and performance – no external dependencies.
  • Multi-Provider Support: Gain flexibility by generating text, images, and videos using major providers such as OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, xAI, and Runway.
  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Maintain security and organization by restricting AI features to specific WordPress roles based on your administrative needs.
  • Localized Content Management: Never lose generated content. Every entry is saved locally along with relevant metadata, allowing you to review, delete, or re-purpose content for site content creation.
  • Media Asset Management: Generate and host images/videos directly on your server. Organize assets by reviewing, deleting or uploading to the media library for workflow integration.
  • Prompt Preservation: Improve repeatable success by saving the exact prompts used to generate every resource, making it easy to reference and iterate on successful results.
  • Reusable Prompt Library: Maintain a private, local repository of high-performing prompts tailored specifically to your brand’s needs across all generation categories.
  • Export Generated Text (Pro): Download generated content as PDF, Open Document (.odt), HTML, and more – simplifying editing in your favourite word processor.

📌 Plugin Pages

  • Complete plugin description
  • Documentation

📌 Full product details and Free vs Pro comparison

For a complete list of features, visit the plugin’s page here. For an in-depth comparison between the two versions, see the Free vs Pro section.

📌 AI Provider Services

Accessing features powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) requires a connection to a third-party provider’s API. Successful interaction depends on a pre-existing agreement between the user and the AI provider regarding authentication, authorization, and identification. This relationship is governed exclusively by the terms of service and privacy policies associated with the user’s AI account and API key.

Example AI Terms and Privacy Policies

Note: The links below are provided as examples only. Because AI providers operate globally, specific terms and privacy policies (between a user and the AI provider) may vary based on geographic region and account type. Users are responsible for ensuring they comply with the specific terms and conditions established by their own AI provider accounts.

  • Google (Gemini): Terms | Privacy
  • OpenAI: Terms | Privacy
  • xAI: Terms | Privacy
  • Anthropic (Claude): Terms | Privacy
  • Runway: Terms | Privacy

Disclaimer

The plugin functions exclusively as a communication bridge. It does not participate in the internal processes or data handling of any third-party AI provider. Users are solely responsible for ensuring that their use of AI services complies with all relevant terms of service, privacy policies, and applicable local or regional laws governing their specific use of AI, API keys and geographical location.

Overview of Plugin Processes

  • The plugin facilitates AI-powered features through the following workflow:
  1. API Key Integration: The plugin requires a valid, unique API key to establish a connection with the AI provider’s services.
  2. Prompt Collection: User prompts and response preferences are collected via UI controls, allowing for default or custom settings.
  3. Request Construction: User configurations are combined with specific LLM endpoint URLs and parameters to build the final request.
  4. Data Transmission: The request is transmitted as a RESTful API call. Responses are received and stored in the WordPress database (and uploads folder) for immediate access and reuse.

AI Provider Base URLs

When transmitting user requests to AI providers, the plugin communicates with the following providers via these base URLs:

  • Google (Gemini):

    • https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions
    • https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models
    • https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/files

  • OpenAI:

    • https://api.openai.com/v1/responses
    • https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations

  • xAI:

    • https://api.x.ai/v1/responses
    • https://api.x.ai/v1/videos/generations
    • https://api.x.ai/v1/videos

  • Anthropic (Claude):

    • https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages

  • Runway:

    • https://api.dev.runwayml.com/v1/text_to_video
    • https://api.dev.runwayml.com/v1/tasks
    • https://api.dev.runwayml.com/v1/text_to_image

Privacy Notice

The only identifying information transmitted by the plugin to third-party AI providers is the user-configured API key. The plugin does not share any personal data, identity details, or sensitive website configurations during these communications.

Plugin’s AI Terms

The plugin’s terms and privacy policy can be reviewed at: Our AI Terms of Use. And, Our Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  • Access your WordPress admin dashboard.
  • Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  • Search for “PASS AI” in the search bar.
  • Click Install Now, then Activate.
  • Visit Productive… > PASS AI to configure plugin settings.

► For comprehensive installation guidance, please consult the plugin’s documentation for step-by-step instructions on both manual and automatic installations.

sections.faq:
Can this plugin be used solely as a multimodal AI generation tool?
Yes, each module can be enabled or disabled independently. All modules are equally capable of running concurrently.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes, it is compatible with any theme that adheres to standard WordPress development guidelines.

How does the Plugin communicate with various AI providers?

All AI connections are made directly between your WordPress site and the AI provider’s API endpoint. When interacting with these services, the plugin calls the public API endpoints provided by the providers to send user requests and receive responses back to your WordPress site. The plugin does not offer any intermediary services. All connections and transactions are directly between your site and the AI provider. To establish a successful connection, authentication is required via your unique API key, which is sent securely with every request.
